description: Imports one public patent publication into the connected organisation, with a complete publication number and explicit purpose. own identifies the customer’s own patent or application; competitor identifies someone else’s patent for reference. Ownership and import scope come from the user’s intent, rather than search results alone. Own-patent imports automatically attempt family grouping with related saved patents, including earlier imports; a separate refresh is not normally needed. Repeated requests return the existing record without updating it. A different purpose or another publication of the same application can produce a conflict identifying the existing record. imported means the record was saved. receipt.status reports complete, partial or incomplete import processing; receipt.warnings explain limitations such as missing PDFs or uncertain family grouping. An incomplete receipt does not mean work is still running; a null receipt means completion details are unavailable. A timed-out request may have saved the record; repeating the same publication and purpose retrieves its saved outcome. Import cannot change an existing record’s purpose or replace its publication.

purpose.description: own for the customer’s own portfolio; competitor for someone else’s patent
